content.value_statement: Email teams need clear audiences without exposing subscriber data or mailing people who opted out. This skill turns user-owned exports into reusable segment rules, aggregate counts, and suppression guidance.
actual_capabilities: Profiles available columns in user-provided email, CRM, analytics, and ecommerce exports.
Defines behavioral segments from measured open, click, browse, cart, and purchase activity.
Creates RFM tiers when recency, frequency, and monetary fields are available.
Maps subscribers to reusable lifecycle stages with stated eligibility rules.
Builds a do-not-mail rule set for unsubscribes, hard bounces, complaints, and withdrawn consent.
Labels segment sizes as Measured or Estimated and identifies missing inputs.
limitations: It does not send email, create campaign copy, or design automation flows.
It cannot infer missing consent, engagement, or order data.
It provides segment definitions and aggregate counts, not raw subscriber records.
Live Resend suppression updates require explicit user action and platform access.

use_cases.title: Prepare a retention audience
use_cases.description: Create engaged, at-risk, lapsed, and win-back definitions from an exported subscriber list.

use_cases.title: Create RFM customer tiers
use_cases.description: Turn ecommerce recency, frequency, and value fields into clear customer tiers.

use_cases.title: Review suppression coverage
use_cases.description: Reconcile opt-outs, bounces, complaints, and consent withdrawals before campaign planning.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: segment a list export
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a subscriber CSV with engagement fields.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build email segments from my list export. My goal is retention. Identify missing columns and give each segment a clear rule and aggregate count.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: create engagement groups
prompt_templates.scenario: You have email and ecommerce exports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create engaged-90d, lapsed, cart-abandoner, and clicked-no-purchase segments from my ESP and ecommerce exports. Include a suppression list.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: map RFM and lifecycle stages
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my CRM export to define RFM tiers and lifecycle stages. Mark every count as Measured or Estimated and flag fields needed for reliable rules.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: validate before a cold campaign
prompt_templates.scenario: You are planning a cold outreach campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this export for a cold campaign audience. Define the eligible seed, build suppression rules, and identify every cohort that needs consent verification.

output_examples.input: A retention export contains last-open date, last-click date, purchase date, opt-in status, and bounce flags.
output: Engaged-90d: opened or clicked within 90 days; Measured count from activity fields.
Lapsed: no open or click for 180 days; Measured count from activity fields.
Suppression: unsubscribed, hard-bounced, complained, or consent-withdrawn; reconcile with the consent registry.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce export includes order date, order count, and lifetime value but no email engagement data.
output: RFM champions: recent, frequent, high-value customers; calculate from supplied order fields.
Lifecycle stages: new, active, at-risk, and lapsed using stated purchase recency rules.
Behavioral email segments: NEEDS_INPUT because engagement fields are absent.

best_practices: Provide only user-owned exports and remove unnecessary columns before analysis.
Use measured source columns for rules and mark missing data as NEEDS_INPUT.
Reconcile every mailing audience against current consent and suppression records.
anti_patterns: Do not assume a subscriber is opted in when no consent record exists.
Do not invent RFM scores when order recency, frequency, or value fields are missing.
Do not include raw email addresses or phone numbers in segment summaries.

faq.question: What data can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a user-owned email, CRM, analytics, or ecommerce export with the available column names and campaign goal.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It creates audience rules and suppression guidance only.

faq.question: Can it create RFM segments?
faq.answer: Yes, when your export includes recency, frequency, and monetary order fields.

faq.question: How are missing fields handled?
faq.answer: The skill marks affected segments as NEEDS_INPUT instead of guessing.

faq.question: How does it handle unsubscribes?
faq.answer: It includes unsubscribes, hard bounces, complaints, and consent withdrawals in the do-not-mail rules.

faq.question: Can it update Resend?
faq.answer: It documents an optional Resend connector. Live suppression changes require explicit user action with the --live flag.
